item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:50 HKT 14/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will continue to bring very hot weather to southeastern China tomorrow. Meanwhile, the tropical cyclone over the central part of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the coast of central Vietnam. Under the combined effect of the subtropical ridge and the tropical cyclone, winds will strengthen slightly and there will be showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With a broad trough of low pressure affecting the northern part of the South China Sea midweek this week, there will still be showers and thunderstorms over the region. The trough of low pressure is expected to weaken slightly in the latter part of this week. The weather will be very hot again over the coastal areas of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 15/07 (Monday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Sunny intervals and a few showers. Showers will be heavier with squally thunderstorms in some areas at first. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
